written.headline: Ethan Mollick tests Fable 5.2 and Gemini Carbon on the Fermi Paradox
written.summary: Ethan Mollick asked Fable 5.2 and Gemini Carbon to solve the Fermi Paradox. The models did not solve the paradox, but produced interesting outputs.

written.headline: Anthropic opens Australian retail IPO ahead of Nasdaq listing
written.summary: Anthropic opened its Australian retail initial public offering, giving individual investors less than a week to buy Class A shares. The company is offering 825 million shares globally at $70 to $78 each ahead of its Nasdaq listing.

written.headline: Study finds KV cache reuse can speed up DeepSeek model updates by up to 5×
written.summary: Researchers examined reusing key‑value caches across four updates of DeepSeek‑V4‑Flash, finding median time‑to‑first‑token speedups of 2.1–5.1× on three longer‑prefix QA benchmarks. Retrieval accuracy varied, ranging from near‑native performance to large losses.

written.headline: ActiveSecHarness proposes neurosymbolic architecture to secure agentic coding harnesses
written.summary: Researchers present ActiveSecHarness, a reference‑monitor system that separates intelligence from authority and uses capability tokens, a taint lattice, and OS‑level guards to block malicious code execution. In tests on 252 fixtures, the system achieved a false‑positive rate of 0 % and blocked all attacks with microsecond‑scale latency.

written.headline: eBay blocks AI shopping agents; Amazon, Target, Walmart take different stances
written.summary: eBay has blocked AI shopping agents, including Meta's Muse, from browsing its listings, joining Amazon in restricting such bots while Target permits approved providers and Walmart partners with AI companies. BrightEdge estimates agent-driven purchases are up 43% monthly, yet only about 3% of e-commerce firms let agents complete transactions.

written.headline: Apple's Claris unit testing Harbor app to run local AI models on Macs
written.summary: Apple's Claris subsidiary is testing an app called Harbor that turns Apple silicon Macs into a private AI inference server, with support for clustering multiple Macs over Thunderbolt 5 to pool unified memory. The app is in private preview and not yet publicly available.

written.headline: eBay blocks Meta’s Muse and other AI agents from browsing site
written.summary: eBay has blocked Meta’s Muse AI agent and other third‑party agents from browsing its marketplace, preventing them from pulling listings or making purchases.
